# Filter and trim

```{r}

# Extract sample names, assuming filenames have format: SAMPLENAME_XXX.fastq
sample.names <- sapply(strsplit(basename(fastq_files_R1), "_"), `[`, 1)

# Place filtered files in filtered/ subdirectory
filtFs <- file.path(pathF, "filtered", paste0(sample.names, "_R1_filt.fastq.gz"))
filtRs <- file.path(pathR, "filtered", paste0(sample.names, "_R2_filt.fastq.gz"))
names(filtFs) <- sample.names
names(filtRs) <- sample.names
```

# Filter

1.  minQ =25. Minimum QC score of 25 was selected.
2.  truncLen = c(270, 210). FastQC+ MultiQC reports were generated, fall of read quality was observed and based on that truncation length of 270 bp for forward reads and 210 bp for reverse reads was selected.
3.  trimLeft=c(20,20) This makes sure that primer sequences are removed from the start of sequences, if we know that primers are already removed then set this to 0, if not sure then set at 20
4.  maxN =0 sequences with more than maxN Ns will be discarded
5.  maxEE=c(2,2) reads with higher than maxEE "expected errors" will be discarded
6.  truncQ=11 Truncate reads at the first instance of a quality score less than or equal to truncQ

```{r}
out <- filterAndTrim(fastq_files_R1, 
                     filtFs, 
                     fastq_files_R2, 
                     filtRs, 
                     minQ = 25, #reads containing a quality score less than minQ will be discarded.
                     truncLen=c(270,210), #Truncate reads after truncLen bases. Reads shorter than this are discarded.
                     trimLeft=c(20,20),#The number of nucleotides to remove from the start of each read. 
                     maxN=0, #sequences with more than maxN Ns will be discarded.
                     maxEE=c(2,2), #reads with higher than maxEE "expected errors" will be discarded. 
                     truncQ=11, #Truncate reads at the first instance of a quality score less than or equal to truncQ.
                     rm.phix=TRUE, #discard reads that match against the phiX genome
                     compress=TRUE, 
                     multithread=FALSE) # On Windows set multithread=FALSE (only needed for filterAndTrim)
head(out)
```

# Sample Inference

We are now ready to apply [the core sample inference algorithm](https://www.nature.com/articles/nmeth.3869#methods) to the filtered and trimmed sequence data.

```{r}
dadaFs <- dada(filtFs, err=errF, multithread=TRUE)
dadaFs[[1]]
```

```{r}
dadaRs <- dada(filtRs, err=errR, multithread=TRUE)
dadaRs[[1]]
```

# Merge paired reads

```{r}

mergers <- mergePairs(dadaFs, filtFs, dadaRs, filtRs, verbose=TRUE)
# Inspect the merger data.frame from the first sample
head(mergers[[1]])

```

# Construct sequence table

We can now construct an amplicon sequence variant table (ASV) table, a higher-resolution version of the OTU table produced by traditional methods.

```{r}
seqtab <- makeSequenceTable(mergers)
dim(seqtab)
```

```{r}
# Inspect distribution of sequence lengths
table(nchar(getSequences(seqtab)))
```

The sequence table is a `matrix` with rows corresponding to (and named by) the samples, and columns corresponding to (and named by) the sequence variants. This table contains 293 ASVs, and the lengths of our merged sequences all fall within the expected range for this V3-V4 amplicon.

# Remove chimeras

```{r}
seqtab.nochim <- removeBimeraDenovo(seqtab, method="consensus", multithread=TRUE, verbose=TRUE)
dim(seqtab.nochim)
```

```{r}
sum(seqtab.nochim)/sum(seqtab)
```

# Track reads through the pipeline

As a final check of our progress, we’ll look at the number of reads that made it through each step in the pipeline:

```{r}
getN <- function(x) sum(getUniques(x))
track <- cbind(out, sapply(dadaFs, getN), sapply(dadaRs, getN), sapply(mergers, getN), rowSums(seqtab.nochim))
# If processing a single sample, remove the sapply calls: e.g. replace sapply(dadaFs, getN) with getN(dadaFs)
colnames(track) <- c("input", "filtered", "denoisedF", "denoisedR", "merged", "nonchim")
rownames(track) <- sample.names
head(track)
```

# Assign taxonomy

It is common at this point, especially in 16S/18S/ITS amplicon sequencing, to assign taxonomy to the sequence variants. The DADA2 package provides a native implementation of the [naive Bayesian classifier method](http://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/17586664) for this purpose. The `assignTaxonomy` function takes as input a set of sequences to be classified and a training set of reference sequences with known taxonomy, and outputs taxonomic assignments with at least `minBoot` bootstrap confidence.

We maintain [formatted training fastas for the RDP training set, GreenGenes clustered at 97% identity, and the Silva reference database](https://benjjneb.github.io/dada2/training.html), and additional trainings fastas suitable for protists and certain specific environments have been contributed. For fungal taxonomy, the General Fasta release files from the [UNITE ITS database](https://unite.ut.ee/repository.php) can be used as is. To follow along, download the `silva_nr99_v138.2_toGenus_trainset.fa.gz` file, and place it in the directory with the fastq files. (Source: <https://benjjneb.github.io/dada2/tutorial.html>)

```{r}
start_time <- Sys.time()
taxa <- assignTaxonomy(seqtab.nochim, "/home/admin/Microbiome/KEM_consolidated_raw_data/KEM_consolidated_raw_data/SILVA_v138.2/silva_nr99_v138.2_toGenus_trainset.fa.gz", multithread=TRUE)

end_time <- Sys.time()

end_time - start_time
```

```{r}
ranks <- c("domain", "phylum", "class", "order", "family", "genus", "species") # ranks of interest
# Convert the output object of class "Taxa" to a matrix analogous to the output from assignTaxonomy
taxid <- t(sapply(ids, function(x) {
        m <- match(ranks, x$rank)
        taxa <- x$taxon[m]
        taxa[startsWith(taxa, "unclassified_")] <- NA
        taxa
}))
```

# Multiple combination of methods: beta diversity

```{r}
#Step 1. prepare data
ps.prop <- transform_sample_counts(ps, function(x) x / sum(x))
ps.prop <- prune_samples(sample_sums(ps.prop) > 0, ps.prop)
ps.prop <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps.prop) > 0, ps.prop)


#2.define distances
dist_methods <- c("bray", "jaccard", "euclidean")
ord_methods  <- c("PCoA", "NMDS")

#Step 3: Loop and generate plots
library(ggplot2)

plots <- list()

for (dist in dist_methods) {
  for (ord in ord_methods) {
    
    ord_obj <- ordinate(ps.prop, method = ord, distance = dist)
    
    p <- plot_ordination(ps.prop, ord_obj, color="Family_status2") +
      geom_point(size=3, alpha=0.7) +
      stat_ellipse(level=0.95) +
      theme_classic() +
      ggtitle(paste(ord, "-", dist))
    
    plots[[paste(ord, dist, sep="_")]] <- p
  }
}


#4. display plots

library(patchwork)

wrap_plots(plots)
```

# Ord plot: PCoA2

```{r}
setwd("/home/admin/Microbiome/Microbiome_R_2026")



library(phyloseq)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

methods <- c("bray", "jaccard", "euclidean", "manhattan", "canberra", "kulczynski")

for (method in methods) {
  
  cat("Running:", method, "\n")
  
  tryCatch({
    
    ord <- ordinate(ps.all_taxa, method = "PCoA", distance = method)
    
    ord_df <- as.data.frame(ord$vectors[,1:2])
    colnames(ord_df) <- c("PCoA1", "PCoA2")
    ord_df$SampleID <- rownames(ord_df)
    
    meta <- as.data.frame(sample_data(ps.all_taxa))
    meta$SampleID <- rownames(meta)
    
    #df <- merge(ord_df, meta, by = "SampleID")
    
    df <- ord_df %>% left_join(meta, by = "SampleID")
    summary_df <- df %>%
      group_by(Family_status2, B12_category) %>%
      summarise(mean_PCoA1 = mean(PCoA1),
                mean_PCoA2 = mean(PCoA2),
                .groups = "drop")
    
    file_name <- paste0("PCoA_", method, ".svg")
    cat("Saving:", file_name, "\n")
    
    svg(file_name, width = 12, height = 10)
    
    p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = PCoA1, y = PCoA2)) +
      geom_point(aes(color = Family_status2, shape = B12_category),
                 size = 4, alpha = 0.7) +
      stat_ellipse(aes(color = Family_status2),
                   type = "t", level = 0.95) +
      geom_point(data = summary_df,
                 aes(x = mean_PCoA1, y = mean_PCoA2,
                     color = Family_status2, shape = B12_category),
                 size = 8) +
      ggtitle(paste("PCoA -", method)) +
      theme_classic()
    
    print(p)
    dev.off()
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("❌ Error in", method, ":", e$message, "\n")
  })
}
```

# Ord plot: NMDS

```{r}
#step1. ordination
ord <- ordinate(ps.prop, method = "NMDS", distance = "bray")

#step2 . extract coordinates
ord_df <- as.data.frame(ord$points[,1:2])


colnames(ord_df) <- c("NMDS1", "NMDS2")

ord_df$SampleID <- rownames(ord_df)

meta <-data.frame(sample_data(ps.prop))

meta$SampleID <- rownames(meta)

df <- merge(ord_df, meta, by= "SampleID")

#step3. summarise by group
library(dplyr)

summary_df <- df %>% group_by(Family_status2, B12_category) %>% summarise(mean_NMDS1 = mean(NMDS1), 
                                                                         mean_NMDS2 = mean(NMDS2), 
                                                                         se_NMDS1 = sd(NMDS1)/sqrt(n()),
                                                                         se_NMDS2 = sd(NMDS2)/sqrt(n()),
                                                                         .groups = "drop"
                                                                         )
  

# step 4:plot
library(ggplot2)

svg("OBJ1_beta_diversity_NMDS_1APR26.svg", width= 30, height=20)
ggplot(na.omit(summary_df), aes(x= mean_NMDS1, y= mean_NMDS2)) + 
  #horizontal bars
geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = mean_NMDS1 - se_NMDS1,
                  xmax = mean_NMDS1 + se_NMDS1),
              height =0) +
  #vertical error bars
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin= mean_NMDS2 - se_NMDS2,
                    ymax = mean_NMDS2 + se_NMDS2), width=0) +
  #points
  geom_point(aes(color = Family_status2, shape = B12_category),  size= 24)+
  geom_vline(xintercept =0, color = "black") + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color= "black")+ 
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = Family_status2), type = "t", level = 0.95, linewidth = 2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 36),
        axis.title = element_text(face = "bold",size = 36),
        legend.text = element_text(face = "bold",size=36),
        legend.title = element_text(face = "bold",size=36))

dev.off()
```

# Calculating

```{r}
library(phyloseq)
library(dplyr)

otu <- as.data.frame(otu_table(ps))
tax <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps))
meta <- as.data.frame(sample_data(ps))

if(taxa_are_rows(ps)) {
  otu <- t(otu)
}


library(tidyr)
library(tibble)

otu_long <- otu %>%
  rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>%
  pivot_longer(-SampleID, names_to="ASV", values_to="Abundance")


tax$ASV <- rownames(tax)


########## Phylum
otu_long <- left_join(otu_long, tax[, c("ASV", "Phylum")], by="ASV")

meta$SampleID <- rownames(meta)

otu_long <- left_join(otu_long, meta, by="SampleID")

otu_present <- otu_long %>%
  filter(Abundance > 0)

phyla_count <- otu_present %>%
  group_by(Family_status2, B12_category, Phylum) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups="drop") %>%
  group_by(Family_status2,B12_category) %>%
  summarise(n_phyla = n_distinct(Phylum))

phyla_count 

########## Family
otu_long <- left_join(otu_long, tax[, c("ASV", "Family")], by="ASV")

meta$SampleID <- rownames(meta)

otu_long <- left_join(otu_long, meta, by="SampleID")

otu_present <- otu_long %>%
  filter(Abundance > 0)

family_count <- otu_present %>%
  group_by(Family_status2, B12_category, Family) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups="drop") %>%
  group_by(Family_status2, B12_category) %>%
  summarise(n_phyla = n_distinct(Family))

family_count
```

# Alpha diversity plots: B12_category \~ Family_status2

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

alpha_long <- alpha_df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Observed, Shannon, Simpson, InvSimpson, Fisher, Chao1),
               names_to = "Metric",
               values_to = "Value") %>%
  na.omit()

# define comparison
my_comparisons <- list(c("B12_deficient", "B12_sufficient"))

svg("alpha_diversity_OBJ1_family_status.svg", width=40, height=30)

ggplot(alpha_long, aes(x = B12_category, y = Value, fill = B12_category)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha=0.8) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color=B12_category),width = 0.2, alpha = 0.5, size=16) +
  
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = my_comparisons,
                     method = "wilcox.test",
                     label = "p.format",
                     step.increase = 0.01,
                     size=16,
                     abel.y = 0.85 * max(alpha_long$Value, na.rm = TRUE)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "B12_deficient" = "red",
    "B12_sufficient" = "darkgreen"
  )) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "B12_deficient" = "red",
    "B12_sufficient" = "darkgreen"
  )) +
  
  facet_grid(Family_status2 ~ Metric, scales = "free_y") +   #
 scale_y_continuous(trans = "log2",expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.25))) + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size=36, face="bold"),
        axis.text = element_text(size=24, face="bold"),
        strip.text = element_text(size=60, face="bold"), strip.background = element_rect(color= "black", linewidth=1),
        panel.border = element_rect(color="black", linewidth = 1),
        legend.text = element_text(size=58),

dev.off()
```

# Barplot: Phylum

```{r}
library(phyloseq)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# 1. transform
ps.rel <- transform_sample_counts(ps.all_taxa, function(x) x / sum(x))

# 2. agglomerate
ps.phylum <- tax_glom(ps.rel, taxrank = "Phylum")

# 3. melt
df_OBJ1_phylum <- psmelt(ps.phylum)

# 4. clean taxonomy
df_OBJ1_phylum$Phylum[is.na(df_OBJ1_phylum$Phylum)] <- "Unknown"

# 5. top taxa
top_taxa <- df_OBJ1_phylum %>%
  group_by(Phylum) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(Abundance)) %>%
  arrange(desc(total)) %>%
  slice(1:5) %>%
  pull(Phylum)

# 6. group others
df_OBJ1_phylum$Phylum_mod <- ifelse(df_OBJ1_phylum$Phylum %in% top_taxa,
                                    df_OBJ1_phylum$Phylum,
                                    "Other")


df_OBJ1_phylum <- df_OBJ1_phylum %>% dplyr::select(OTU, Sample, Abundance, SampleID, File_IDs, File_Ids2, SampleName, Family_no, Family_status, Family_status2, Category, Follow.up.timepoint, B12_combined, B12_category, B12_combined_timepoint, Gender, Kingdom, Phylum, Phylum_mod)

# 7. plot
svg("barplot_phylum_OBJ1.svg", width=30, height=10)
ggplot(na.omit(df_OBJ1_phylum), aes(x = B12_category, y = Abundance, fill = Phylum_mod)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill") +
  facet_wrap(~Family_status2, nrow = 1) +
  theme_light() +
  labs(x = "", y = "Relative abundance") +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 24, angle = 0, vjust = 0.5), 
        axis.title = element_text(size=36), 
        legend.text = element_text(size=36),
        legend.title = element_text(size=36))

dev.off()
```

compare all genus

```{r}
library(dplyr)

df_genus <- df_OBJ1_Genus %>%
  filter(!is.na(B12_category)) %>%   # remove NA group
  group_by(SampleID, Family_status2, B12_category, Genus) %>%
  summarise(Abundance = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop")


results <- df_genus %>%
  group_by(Genus, Family_status2) %>%
  
  # ensure both groups exist
  filter(n_distinct(B12_category) == 2) %>%
  
  summarise(
    n_def = sum(B12_category == "B12_deficient"),
    n_suff = sum(B12_category == "B12_sufficient"),
    
    p_value = wilcox.test(Abundance ~ B12_category)$p.value,
    
    median_def = median(Abundance[B12_category == "B12_deficient"]),
    median_suff = median(Abundance[B12_category == "B12_sufficient"]),
    
    effect = median_suff - median_def,   # direction of change
    
    .groups = "drop"
  )


results <- results %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"))

head(results)
write.csv(results, "B12_status_in_Genus_Family_wise.csv")
```

```{r}
    n_suff = sum(B12_category == "B12_sufficient"),
    
    p_value = wilcox.test(Abundance ~ B12_category)$p.value,
    
    median_def = median(Abundance[B12_category == "B12_deficient"]),
    median_suff = median(Abundance[B12_category == "B12_sufficient"]),
    
    effect = median_suff - median_def,
    
    .groups = "drop"
  )

results <- results %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"))

head(results)

write.csv(results, "Only_B12_status_in_Genus.csv")
```

Tree building

```{r}
seqs <- getSequences(seqtab.nochim)
names(seqs) <- seqs   # required for tree building


library(DECIPHER)
library(Biostrings)

dna <- DNAStringSet(seqs)

alignment <- AlignSeqs(dna, anchor = NA)
library(phangorn)

# convert alignment
phang.align <- phyDat(as(alignment, "matrix"), type = "DNA")

# distance matrix
dm <- dist.ml(phang.align)

# initial tree (neighbor-joining)
treeNJ <- NJ(dm)

# maximum likelihood tree
fit <- pml(treeNJ, data = phang.align)

fitGTR <- optim.pml(fit,
                    model = "GTR",
                    optInv = TRUE,
                    optGamma = TRUE,
                    rearrangement = "stochastic",
                    control = pml.control(trace = 0))


ps.all_taxa <- phyloseq(
  otu_table(ps.all_taxa),
  tax_table(ps.all_taxa),
  sample_data(ps.all_taxa),
  phy_tree(fitGTR$tree)
)

phy_tree(ps.all_taxa)
```
